split_manifest.strategy: temporal, grouped by conversation and customer
split_manifest.dropped_reason: conversation crossed a split boundary in time, or customer appeared in a later split (earlier pairs discarded so the evaluation pool keeps its data)

provenance.note: Exploratory evidence only. No cluster assignment is a label. Discovery is restricted to the train split so the held-out test pool, from which the golden set is drawn, remains unseen at taxonomy-design time.
